summary: Closed review R1 and A2 with RED/GREEN regressions: lock-token write/flush failures now clean invocation-owned artifacts and allow retry, and runs roots equal to or contained by the template are rejected before any copy or durable artifact.

claims.claim: Current and immutable revision 3 contracts are byte-identical.
R1 is closed for caught lock-token write and flush failures.
evidence: Exclusive lock ownership is recorded immediately after open(x) succeeds.
Both injected modes leave an empty failure inventory and then succeed on same-ID retry.

claims.claim: A2 is closed without recursive copy.
evidence: Equal and descendant resolved runs roots raise ValueError before runs-root creation or copytree; sentinel call count remains zero.

claims.claim: Atomic publication and v0.2 receipt compatibility remain intact.
evidence: All seven prior materializer tests and two new regressions pass on Python 3.10 and 3.11.
Function signature and five MaterializeReceipt fields are unchanged.

uncertainty: Process termination/machine crash and stale-lock reclamation remain outside the caught-exception guarantee.
